profile.headline: Frontend Web Developer at 1-800Accountant
profile.summary:
I've always had a passion for computers, competition, and problem solving. Self-competition is one of my greatest strengths, focusing on bettering myself day after day gives me motivation to push forward in tough times. The satisfaction from optimizing and refining my web applications is unlike any other. Over the last year I've been developing web applications in JavaScript using React and Redux, as well as Python3. I've always loved a challenge. Struggling, learning, and overcoming are parts of the natural cycle for pushing myself to learn more, and become an even more experienced software engineer. 

Languages: Python 3, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
Technologies: React, Redux, Express, Sequelize, Pug, Flask, SQLAlchemy, Jinja2, Node.js, PostgreSQL, SQL, Docker, Git
Design Technologies: Adobe Creative Cloud ( Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects )

positions.title: Retail Supervisor
positions.description:
Managed day to day operations of the retail CVS Health store along side the Store Manager. 

- Trained new employees on store policy and daily operations
- Handled customer feedback with customer service and empathy
- Worked in a small team delegating daily tasks.

positions.title: Peer Ambassador
positions.description:
As a peer ambassador at the Office of Student Life, it was my duty to create a welcoming environment for  students/faculty/visitors who entered our office.

- Prepared fresh lunch packages daily for 50+ students
- Lead students through the anonymous food pantry process
- Photographed and printed id's for 300+ students through out each quarter
- Inputted/tracked/validated records for student bus passes
- Communicated among different teams/offices to provide the best experience for students

company.name: The Office of Student Life at Clover Park Technical College

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Handled day to day operations of Madeleine Bread and Dessert.

- Managed a small team of 3
- Used customer feedback to implement seasonal specials generating a 20% increase in profits
- Maintained composure in a high-pace and high-stress environment
- Trained new members of our team to the kitchen standards at a rapid pace.

positions.title: Social Media Manager
positions.description:
Handled all social media pages for a local dance team.

- Planned/executed social media campaigns, recruitment videos, and community outreach events
- Recorded/edited/posted videos to be shared through social media platforms
- Generated 15,000+ views through social media
- Managed schedules for 8-15 dance team members
- Responded to questions and comments to our dance team such as tryout periods, event info.
- Handled scheduling of performances when inquired through different organizations
